connector.name: RevOrbit CRM
connector.registryDescription: Search, summarize, and update your RevOrbit CRM (leads, deals, contacts, tasks) in plain language.
connector.summary: Hosted at crm.revorbit.com over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.revorbit, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token using a RevOrbit personal API token — create one at Profile → API Tokens in the CRM, then use the value: Bearer rvo_...
